text: On top of all that, the phone I want to upgrade to on Sprint? I can get it cheaper on another carrier, and that's without any upgrade discount. I had to weigh the pros and cons, and in the end I'd rather pay the extra $12.00 a month and actually get what I'm paying for. I really hoped Sprint would get its act together, but sadly it doesn't look like that's happening anytime soon. Sorry about the 2 stars, but honestly, that's all Sprint deserves these days.
